description: SPDR S&P MidCap 400 ETF Trust, launched in 1995, was the first mid-cap ETF and tracks the S&P MidCap 400 Index — 400 U.S. companies that fall below large-cap thresholds but above small-cap. Mid-cap companies are often cited as a 'sweet spot' in the size spectrum: large enough to have established businesses, but small enough to retain meaningful growth potential. MDY has an expense ratio of 0.23% and approximately $24 billion in assets, with a dividend yield around 0.92%.
